headline: Exchange seeks clarification from Gulf Oil Lubricants on acquisition news
hook: Expansion plans under review at Gulf Oil
summary: The stock exchange has asked Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited to clarify a recent news report regarding the Hinduja group scouting acquisitions in Asia and South America. Tirex currently supplies charging infrastructure to major automotive players including MG and VinFast. For Indian retail investors, this outlines the company's strategic roadmap in both traditional lubricants and emerging EV segments.
